messages.chains: run the five C-call chains (pcall, resume, __index through table.concat, __tostring through string.format, and the __index one under xpcall) to the limit
messages.json: the same chains, with json.encode of a 16-deep table and json.decode of a 16-deep array at the bottom of each, both ending in a 17-digit float (under xpcall, at the bottom of the message handler)
messages.xpcall: the __index chain under xpcall alone: its message handler runs at the limit, nests pcall to level 43 where Lua stops it, and runs json there
messages.floats: json round trips of 0.1, 5e-324, 1e+100, -1e-07 and 9007199254740993: the text printed (a subnormal's differs by libc) and whether it reads back
messages.floats_exact: 1000 floats of 17 digits through encode and decode: how many come back as the same double
messages.floats_time: {n, decode, digits, scale}: n encodes (or decodes) of 1000 floats: of 17 digits (digits 17, the default) or at most 15 (digits 15), times scale
messages.widgets: 128 widgets of every kind, boxes 4 deep (a box in the fifth is refused: nest), handlers, a 256-byte text; returns where to tap the deepest
messages.hits: the events the handlers have seen
